name: youtube-agent-multicanal
description: Multi-channel fork of Jake Schincariol's YouTube agent skill. Twenty Claude skills for a YouTube channel. Seven start one from nothing: niche and sub-niche with measured room, reference channels, names with checked handles, a voice measured from you talking, logo and banner previewed at real size, and the description. Eleven run it: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds the exact moments people leave, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, and a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple rather than by channel size. Two more serve channels made by a pipeline: a review before production and an upload pack after the edit. Tools work in English and Spanish.
